newsitem.title: GERMANY: German FDP wants law change on Telekom sale.
newsitem.headline: German FDP wants law change on Telekom sale.

text.p: Germany's Free Democrats (FDP) said on Wednesday that it would be necessary to pass an amendment to existing law for an early sale on the stock exchange of the government's Deutsche Telekom shares.
"A change in the law would be the least complicated way," said Rainer Funke, state secretary in the Federal Justice Ministry.
"A change in the law is necessary if the government wants to sell shares on the market" before the year 2000, he added.

The early sale of the government's stake was also appropriate because Deutsche Telekom did not appear to require additional capital itself. It would, in fact, gain more for further privatisation efforts, Funke said.
"The more the government reduces its stake, the better Telekom's position will be," said Funke.
